First month: \(5(3000)+2(3500)=22000\) calories/week, so \(22000\times4=88000\) calories.  
Second month: \(5(4000)+2(4500)=29000\) calories/week, so \(29000\times4=116000\) calories.  

Total calories: \(88000+116000=204000\).  
Weight gain: \(\frac{204000}{3500}=\frac{408}{7}=58\frac{2}{7}\) pounds.  
New weight: \(70+58\frac{2}{7}=128\frac{2}{7}\) pounds.  

\boxed{\text{Weight gain }58\frac{2}{7}\text{ lb; new weight }128\frac{2}{7}\text{ lb}}
